crossRefs.note: For if the rejection of them is the reconciling of the world, what would their acceptance be, but life from the dead?
I saw thrones, and they sat on them, and judgment was given to them. I saw the souls of those who had been beheaded for…

translations.web: Blessed is he who waits, and comes to the one thousand three hundred thirty-five days.
translations.bsb: Blessed is he who waits and reaches the end of the 1,335 days.
translations.kjv: Blessed is he that waiteth, and cometh to the thousand three hundred and five and thirty days.
translations.asv: Blessed is he that waiteth, and cometh to the thousand three hundred and five and thirty days.
